Program Review evaluated all five independently and recorded Hold for every object because current main contains no explicit authorization for a lifecycle transition. This is a governed zero-output success: no lifecycle transition and no Program Publication was invented.

program.output: Five authoritative independent Program queues reviewed; 5 Hold decisions, 0 lifecycle transitions and 0 Program publications. The 2026-08-10 Research Program Runtime is execution-closed as Completed.
program.output_zh: 五个权威独立 Program Queue 已完成评审：5 个 Hold、0 个生命周期转换、0 个 Program 发布。2026-08-10 Research Program Runtime 已以 Completed 状态执行闭合。
